recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. FHIR-19448's missing-binding problem is resolved, and changing the binding back to ValueSet/languages-only would conflict with later Applied issue FHIR-46074.
issue_request: FHIR-19448 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution asking to add the missing required value-set binding for TerminologyCapabilities.codeSystem.version.language, aligned with the CodeSystem resource language binding.
initial_application: Git commit 1e011219c1eb2738181c75f2f4add7fc85e3e4c8 applied FHIR-19448 by removing the no-binding marker and adding a required Language binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/languages for TerminologyCapabilities.codeSystem.version.language.
additional_context: TerminologyCapabilities is active and normative in source/fhir.ini. Later Applied issue FHIR-46074 changed the same binding to the CapabilityStatement.acceptLanguage pattern: required http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/all-languages with http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/languages as a starter additional binding. Duplicate FHIR-38734 raised the same concern about the original common-languages-only required binding. Git commit 39f96b21ce8d65b5b086b3ee61a455e47a359a98 implemented the later all-languages binding shape, and fe420c6da27922e6389606384ba06af8bf20b0ae added the key required on the additional binding.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source/terminologycapabilities/structuredefinition-TerminologyCapabilities.xml element has a required Language binding to all-languages and a starter additional binding to ValueSet/languages, matching current CodeSystem and Resource language-binding practice.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 decision changed the same TerminologyCapabilities.codeSystem.version.language binding to required all-languages with ValueSet/languages as a starter additional binding.
Duplicate of FHIR-46074 that identified the original ValueSet/languages-only required binding as too narrow.
Later source commit added the key required on the additional binding, leaving the current binding structurally complete.
